<!-- wp:html -->
<style>
/* ====== Nodarishub HOME — SOLO CONTENIDO (sin header/footer) · tokens + animaciones GPU ====== */
:root{
  --ink:#0E1726;--cobalt:#2F6BFF;--mint:#00E0A4;--fog:#F5F8FC;--slate:#5B6B82;--white:#fff;
  --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#2F6BFF,#00E0A4);--radius:10px;--radius-lg:20px;
  --shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(14,23,38,.05);--shadow-lg:0 22px 50px rgba(14,23,38,.09);
  --shadow-xl:0 34px 70px rgba(14,23,38,.16);--maxw:1180px;
  --fdisplay:'Space Grotesk','Space Grotesk Light',system-ui,sans-serif;--fbody:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
}
.nh-home *{box-sizing:border-box}
.nh-home{font-family:var(--fbody);font-weight:400;color:var(--ink);font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.6;background:#fff;overflow-x:hidden;width:100%;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.nh-home img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.nh-home h1,.nh-home h2,.nh-home h3{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
.nh-home a{color:var(--cobalt);text-decoration:none}
.nh-wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:clamp(1rem,4vw,2rem);width:100%}
.nh-sec{padding-block:clamp(3.75rem,8.5vw,6.75rem)}
.nh-eyebrow{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--cobalt);margin:0 0 .6rem}
.nh-eyebrow.is-mint{color:var(--mint)}
.nh-h2{font-size:clamp(1.75rem,3.8vw,2.6rem)}
.nh-head{margin-bottom:3rem;max-width:60ch}
.nh-head.center{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center}
.nh-head .nh-h2{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding-bottom:.5rem}
.nh-head .nh-h2::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:54px;height:4px;background:var(--grad);border-radius:4px}
.nh-head.center .nh-h2::after{left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.nh-lead{color:var(--slate);max-width:64ch;margin:.7rem 0 0}
.nh-head.center .nh-lead{margin-inline:auto}
/* Cabecera asimétrica: título izq · lead der */
.nh-head--split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(1rem,4vw,3rem);align-items:end;max-width:none;margin-bottom:3.2rem}
.nh-head--split .nh-lead{margin:0;align-self:end}
.nh-link{position:relative;font-weight:600;display:inline-block}
.nh-link::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-2px;height:2px;width:100%;background:var(--mint);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .25s ease}
.nh-link:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
/* Botones (scopeados para vencer a .nh-home a) */
.nh-home .nh-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.1;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:.85rem 1.6rem;min-height:48px;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid transparent;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .2s ease,background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,border-color .2s ease;will-change:transform}
.nh-home .nh-btn svg{flex:0 0 auto}
.nh-home .nh-btn--primary{background:var(--cobalt);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(47,107,255,.4)}
.nh-home .nh-btn--primary:hover{background:var(--mint);color:var(--ink);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,224,164,.42)}
.nh-home .nh-btn--outline{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#fff;border-color:var(--mint)}
.nh-home .nh-btn--outline:hover{background:var(--mint);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--mint);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,224,164,.35)}
.nh-home .nh-btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--cobalt);border-color:var(--cobalt)}
.nh-home .nh-btn--ghost:hover{background:var(--cobalt);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.nh-home .nh-btn--white{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.nh-home .nh-btn--white:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.nh-home .nh-btn--lg{font-size:1.08rem;padding:1rem 2rem;min-height:54px}
/* HERO */
.nh-hero{position:relative;min-height:90vh;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;isolation:isolate}
.nh-hero__bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:-3}
.nh-hero__overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(14,23,38,.95),rgba(14,23,38,.8) 52%,rgba(23,43,77,.64))}
.nh-hero__mesh{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:-1;opacity:.6;pointer-events:none}
.nh-hero__logo{width:clamp(150px,17vw,190px);height:auto;margin-bottom:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.2rem)}
.nh-hero .nh-wrap{padding-block:clamp(4.5rem,9vw,6rem)}
.nh-hero h1{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,6.4vw,4.6rem);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.025em;max-width:15ch;font-weight:600}
.nh-accent{color:#5b8bff}
.nh-hero__eyebrow{margin-bottom:1rem}
.nh-sub{color:#D7E0EC;font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.6vw,1.24rem);max-width:52ch;margin:1.3rem 0 1.9rem}
.nh-hero__btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.nh-trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.55rem 1.4rem;margin-top:2rem;color:#AEBBCD;font-size:.85rem}
.nh-trust span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem}
.nh-trust svg{flex:0 0 auto}
@keyframes nh-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.3}50%{opacity:1}}
@keyframes nh-draw{0%{stroke-dashoffset:var(--len)}55%,100%{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@keyframes nh-float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
@keyframes nh-float2{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(7px)}}
.nh-hero__mesh .nd{animation:nh-pulse 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-hero__mesh .ln{stroke-dasharray:var(--len);stroke-dashoffset:var(--len);animation:nh-draw 4.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.nh-hero__mesh .grp{animation:nh-float 9s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-hero__mesh .grp2{animation:nh-float2 11s ease-in-out infinite}
/* HERO — escena SVG animada a código (reemplaza la imagen estática) */
.nh-hero{background:radial-gradient(125% 100% at 76% 18%,#18305A 0%,#101D33 48%,#0B1220 100%)}
.nh-hero__glow{position:absolute;z-index:-2;top:-12%;right:-8%;width:72%;height:92%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 40%,rgba(47,107,255,.30),rgba(0,224,164,.10) 42%,transparent 66%);animation:nh-breathe 9s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-hero__scene{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}
.nh-hero__scene .ln{stroke-dasharray:var(--len);stroke-dashoffset:var(--len);animation:nh-draw 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.nh-hero__scene .nd{animation:nh-pulse 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-hero__scene .l0{opacity:.16}
.nh-hero__scene .l1{opacity:.32;animation:nh-float 15s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-hero__scene .l2{opacity:.56;animation:nh-float2 12s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-hero__scene .l3{opacity:.92;animation:nh-float 10s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes nh-breathe{0%,100%{opacity:.5}50%{opacity:.95}}
/* MARQUEE — cinta infinita GPU */
.nh-marquee{background:var(--fog);border-block:1px solid #E7EDF4;overflow:hidden;padding-block:clamp(.55rem,1.4vw,.85rem)}
.nh-marquee__track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:nh-scroll 55s linear infinite;will-change:transform}
.nh-marquee:hover .nh-marquee__track{animation-play-state:paused}
.nh-marquee__item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:1.1rem;padding-inline:1.1rem;font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.4vw,1.15rem);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#93A1B5;white-space:nowrap}
.nh-marquee__item .dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mint);flex:0 0 auto;opacity:.5}
@keyframes nh-scroll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
/* CLIENTES — mini-franja ink con logos reales */
.nh-clients{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.nh-clients .nh-wrap{padding-block:clamp(2.6rem,5.5vw,3.8rem)}
.nh-clients__head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.85rem;margin-bottom:1.9rem}
.nh-clients__mark{width:34px;height:34px;flex:0 0 auto}
.nh-clients__lead{letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem;color:#8FA0B8;margin:0}
.nh-clients__row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}
.nh-client{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.85rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);border-radius:16px;padding:1rem 1.15rem;min-width:0;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .28s ease,border-color .28s ease,background-color .28s ease,box-shadow .28s ease;will-change:transform}
.nh-client:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(0,224,164,.5);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.nh-home .nh-client__logo{height:auto;max-height:40px;width:auto;max-width:92px;box-sizing:content-box;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:.5rem .7rem;flex:0 0 auto;object-fit:contain}
.nh-client__mono{display:grid;place-items:center;height:40px;min-width:52px;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:.5rem .7rem;flex:0 0 auto;font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--cobalt);letter-spacing:.01em;box-sizing:content-box}
.nh-client__meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.15rem}
.nh-client__name{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;color:#fff;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.2}
.nh-client__ctx{color:#9AA7BA;font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.3}
/* GRID genérico con profundidad (perspectiva) */
.nh-grid{display:grid;gap:1.6rem;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);perspective:1400px}
.nh-card{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid #EDF2F8;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:2.2rem;transition:transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .38s ease,border-color .38s ease;will-change:transform;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.nh-card:hover{transform:translateY(-9px) rotateX(3.5deg) rotateY(-3.5deg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl);border-color:rgba(47,107,255,.35)}
.nh-card__top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1.15rem}
/* Número de TARJETA (índice menor, subordinado al número de SECCIÓN) */
.nh-num{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#AEBBCD;transition:color .38s ease}
.nh-card:hover .nh-num{color:rgba(47,107,255,.55)}
.nh-ico{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(47,107,255,.1),rgba(0,224,164,.1));transition:transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),background-color .38s ease;will-change:transform}
.nh-card:hover .nh-ico{transform:scale(1.12) translateZ(26px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(47,107,255,.2),rgba(0,224,164,.2))}
.nh-card h3{font-size:1.22rem;margin-bottom:.55rem}
.nh-home .nh-card h3 a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s ease}
.nh-home .nh-card h3 a:hover{color:var(--cobalt)}
.nh-card__links{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.55rem 1.15rem;padding-top:1.15rem}
.nh-home .nh-card__links .nh-link{margin-top:0}
.nh-home .nh-card__links .nh-link--cta{background:rgba(47,107,255,.09);border-radius:8px;padding:.44rem .8rem;color:var(--cobalt);transition:background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease}
.nh-home .nh-card__links .nh-link--cta::after{display:none}
.nh-home .nh-card__links .nh-link--cta:hover{background:var(--cobalt);color:#fff}
.nh-card p{color:var(--slate);margin:0 0 1.1rem;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.65}
.nh-card .nh-link{margin-top:auto}
/* WHY US con números editoriales */
.nh-why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1.5rem;perspective:1400px}
.nh-why .it{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid #EDF2F8;border-radius:16px;padding:1.9rem;transition:transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .38s ease;will-change:transform;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.nh-why .it:hover{transform:translateY(-8px) rotateX(3deg) rotateY(-3deg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl)}
.nh-why .nh-ico{margin-bottom:0}
.nh-why h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin:.9rem 0 .4rem}
.nh-why p{color:var(--slate);font-size:.92rem;margin:0}
/* CTA BAND */
.nh-ctaband{position:relative;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}
.nh-ctaband .nh-wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;padding-block:clamp(4.5rem,10vw,7rem);max-width:720px}
.nh-ctaband h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(1.85rem,3.8vw,2.7rem);line-height:1.16}
.nh-ctaband p{color:#AEBBCD;margin:1.1rem auto 2.2rem;max-width:46ch;font-size:1.12rem}
.nh-ctaband__mark{width:40px;height:40px;margin:0 auto 1.3rem}
/* SUPPORT — layout invertido, imagen sangrando al borde */
.nh-support{background:var(--fog);overflow:hidden}
.nh-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,3.4rem);align-items:center}
.nh-split--bleed{grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr}
.nh-split__media{position:relative}
.nh-split__img{border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(47,107,255,.28),0 22px 50px rgba(14,23,38,.14),0 0 48px rgba(47,107,255,.10),0 0 30px rgba(0,224,164,.08);width:100%;max-height:460px;object-fit:cover}
/* Escena SVG en seccion BLANCA (transparente, integrada al blanco) */
.nh-ws{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;max-width:520px;margin-inline:auto}
.nh-ws .wl{stroke-dasharray:var(--len);stroke-dashoffset:var(--len);animation:nh-draw 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.nh-ws .wn{animation:nh-pulse 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-ws .wf{animation:nh-float 13s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-ws .wf2{animation:nh-float2 16s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-ws .wlit{animation:nh-litw 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-ws .wpulse{animation:nh-travelw 3s linear infinite}
.nh-ws .wgear{animation:nh-spin 16s linear infinite}
@keyframes nh-litw{0%,100%{opacity:.05}50%{opacity:.15}}
@keyframes nh-travelw{0%{transform:translateX(0);opacity:0}12%{opacity:1}88%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateX(118px);opacity:0}}
@keyframes nh-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes nh-float2{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(7px)}}

.nh-split__badge{position:absolute;left:-14px;bottom:-14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #EDF2F8;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:.9rem 1.15rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;max-width:220px}
.nh-split__badge b{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1}
.nh-split__badge span{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.25}
.nh-flist{list-style:none;margin:1.1rem 0 1.4rem;padding:0;display:grid;gap:.6rem}
.nh-flist li{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--slate)}
.nh-flist svg{margin-top:.15rem;flex:0 0 auto}
/* FAQ */
.nh-faqsec{background:#fff}
.nh-faq{display:grid;gap:.8rem;max-width:840px;margin-inline:auto}
.nh-faq details{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E4ECF5;border-radius:14px;padding:0 1.3rem;transition:box-shadow .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}
.nh-faq details[open]{border-color:var(--cobalt);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.nh-faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1rem;padding:1.05rem 0;font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);font-size:1.03rem}
.nh-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.nh-faq summary .ic{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;height:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .25s ease}
.nh-faq details[open] summary .ic{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.nh-faq .ans{padding:0 0 1.15rem;color:var(--slate)}
/* WhatsApp flotante (se queda) */
.nh-wa{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:95;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:#25D366;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.28);transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;will-change:transform}
.nh-wa:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.05);box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(37,211,102,.5)}
.nh-wa svg{width:32px;height:32px;display:block}
/* Separadores nodo */
.nh-edge-top{position:relative}
.nh-edge-top::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--cobalt) 22%,var(--mint) 50%,var(--cobalt) 78%,transparent);z-index:2}
.nh-divider{line-height:0;margin-top:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,2.5rem)}
.nh-divider svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible}
/* Reveal — direccional + stagger (1 solo IntersectionObserver) */
.nh-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);will-change:opacity,transform}
.nh-reveal--l{transform:translateX(-46px)}
.nh-reveal--r{transform:translateX(46px)}
.nh-reveal.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.nh-d1{transition-delay:.06s}.nh-d2{transition-delay:.14s}.nh-d3{transition-delay:.22s}
.nh-d4{transition-delay:.3s}.nh-d5{transition-delay:.38s}.nh-d6{transition-delay:.46s}
/* ===== Sistema editorial: cabecera de sección con número grande tenue ===== */
.nh-secnum{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(.9rem,2vw,1.6rem);margin-bottom:clamp(1.6rem,3.2vw,2.4rem)}
.nh-secnum__n{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5vw,3.4rem);line-height:.85;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:#E8EEF6;flex:0 0 auto}
.nh-secnum__line{flex:1 1 auto;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#E1E9F2,rgba(225,233,242,0))}
.nh-secnum__label{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--slate);flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap}
.nh-secnum--ink .nh-secnum__n{color:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.nh-secnum--ink .nh-secnum__line{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.16),rgba(255,255,255,0))}
.nh-secnum--ink .nh-secnum__label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}
/* ===== PARA TI — audiencias segmentadas ===== */
.nh-aud{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1.4rem}
.nh-aud__card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;border:1px solid #EDF2F8;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:1.8rem 1.6rem;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .34s ease,border-color .34s ease;will-change:transform}
.nh-aud__card:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl);border-color:rgba(47,107,255,.32)}
.nh-aud__node{position:absolute;right:-16px;top:-16px;width:94px;height:94px;opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}
.nh-aud__tag{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--cobalt);margin:0 0 .9rem;position:relative}
.nh-aud__msg{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;font-size:1.24rem;line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 .55rem}
.nh-aud__desc{color:var(--slate);font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 1.3rem}
.nh-aud__foot{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.65rem;align-items:flex-start}
.nh-home .nh-aud__cta{font-family:var(--fdisplay);font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;color:#fff;background:var(--cobalt);border-radius:9px;padding:.55rem .95rem;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(47,107,255,.28);transition:transform .2s ease,background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.nh-home .nh-aud__cta:hover{background:var(--mint);color:var(--ink);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,224,164,.32)}
.nh-aud__link{position:relative;font-weight:600;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--cobalt)}
.nh-aud__link::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-2px;height:2px;width:100%;background:var(--mint);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .25s ease}
.nh-aud__card:hover .nh-aud__link::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
